    # Check for leading zeros
    if dollar_string.startswith('0'):
        # Remove leading zeros
        dollar_string = dollar_string[1:]

    # Check if the dollar string is positive
    if dollar_string.isdigit():

        formatted_string = f"{float(dollar_string):.2f} dollars and {float(dollar_string) - int(dollar_string):.2f} cents"
